recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: 2 mg: pink tablets debossed with "GS" and "3V2", 4 mg: light brown tablets debossed with "GS" and "WXG", 6 mg: white tablets debossed with "GS" and "11F", 8 mg: red tablets debossed with "GS" and "5CC", 12 mg: green tablets debossed with "GS" and "YX7"
mechanism_of_action: an orally administered non-ergoline dopamine agonist
side_effects: nausea, dizziness, drowsiness or sleepiness, headache, sudden uncontrolled movements (dyskinesia), increase or decrease in blood pressure and heart rate, hallucinations, new or increased gambling, sexual, or other intense urges
